facts.fact: UNICEF's country profile, compiled December 2016 to November 2017, states under both birth and death registration that processing is electronic and that all vital events are recorded directly in the computer using specific applications; marriages are processed the same way.
facts.system: civil registry applications in the conservatórias

facts.fact: UNICEF's profile, compiled to November 2017, states that all vital events are recorded directly in the computer, using applications located in the civil registry conservatórias, with a certificate issued immediately; it does not say where the record is held or that it is held in a national register.
facts.system: civil registry applications in the conservatórias

facts.fact: UNICEF's profile, compiled to November 2017, states that the applications in which vital events are recorded are available in all municipalities of the country, in the civil registry conservatórias, with civil registration services in all 22 municipalities (22 of 22, a share of municipalities); it adds that registration stations exist only in the urban centres of the 22 municipalities, rural communities having been reached by mobile teams during the birth registration project and by registration in health structures then being introduced.
facts.system: civil registry applications in the conservatórias

facts.fact: UNICEF's profile, compiled to November 2017, names the Directorate of Registries, Notaries and Identification of the Ministry of Justice as the authority registering births and deaths, in a centralised structure with services in all 22 municipalities, under the Civil Registry Code, Law 75/VIII/2014.
facts.system: civil registry applications in the conservatórias

systems.system: civil registry applications in the conservatórias
systems.country_label: specific applications located in civil registry conservatories
systems.owner: Directorate of Registries, Notaries and Identification (Ministry of Justice)
systems.tiers: conservatórias in the urban centres of all 22 municipalities; places of registration also listed as the central office, hospitals and health centres, and mobile stations

systems.system: mobile teams of the birth registration project
systems.tiers: moved to scattered rural communities during the birth registration project; how they recorded is not stated

systems.system: registration of births and deaths in health structures
systems.country_label: registration in health structures (hospital / health centre as place of registration)
systems.tiers: measures being taken in 2016-17 to register births and deaths in health structures; how the record is made there is not described

systems.system: Ministry of Health birth and death certificate
systems.country_label: certificate delivered by the Ministry of Health
systems.tiers: the ministry records the birth or death and gives the family a certificate with which to obtain the Directorate's services, a burial authorisation or a birth extract

systems.country_label: vital statistical service of the National Institute of Statistics
systems.tiers: national; registered birth and death certificates are transmitted to the institute, which receives the civil registry's databases of births, deaths and marriages on request, under a protocol updated in 2014
